newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SABIC wins Pakistan one-year term MTBE buy tender.
newsitem.headline: SABIC wins Pakistan one-year term MTBE buy tender.

text.p: Pakistan's Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Resources has awarded its annual term tender to buy 96,000 tonnes of methyl tertiary butyl ether (MTBE) to Saudi Basic Industries Corp (SABIC), an industry source said on Thursday.
The tender which was awarded on June 14, sought two 4,000 tonne cargoes of the gasoline octane booster per month between July 1997 and June 1998.
The award, at $3.00 per tonne over the mean of Singapore MTBE spot quotes on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Keamari is $10 higher than the current contract.
Under the current July 1996-June 1997 contract, SABIC supplied 8,000 to 10,000 tonnes of MTBE a month at a discount of $7.00 to Singapore quotes, c-and-f.
